def verify_costas(perm):
    n = len(perm)
    print(f"Permutation: {perm}")
    print(f"Rows: {list(range(n))}")
    print(f"Cols: {list(range(n))}")
    vectors = {}
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(i+1, n):
            dr = perm[j] - perm[i]
            dc = j - i
            if (dr, dc) in vectors:
                print(f"Conflict: ({dr},{dc}) from cols ({i},{j}) and {vectors[(dr,dc)]}")
                return False
            vectors[(dr, dc)] = (i, j)
    print(f"All {n*(n-1)//2} vectors distinct!")
    print(f"Vectors: {sorted(vectors.keys())}")
    return True

sol = [0, 1, 5, 3, 6, 2, 4]
verify_costas(sol)
